title: Recount Text
summary: Recount text untuk TKA: jenis recount (pribadi, faktual, imajinatif), struktur orientation–events–reorientation, ciri kebahasaan past tense dan penanda waktu, serta latihan mengurutkan peristiwa.

blocks.html:
Recount text menceritakan kembali peristiwa yang sudah terjadi secara berurutan, untuk memberi informasi atau menghibur. Bentuknya bisa catatan harian, laporan kegiatan, pengalaman magang, biografi singkat, atau laporan peristiwa sejarah.

BagianIsi
Orientationsiapa, kapan, di mana, dan apa yang terjadi
Eventsrangkaian peristiwa secara kronologis
Reorientationpenutup: kesan, pendapat, atau pelajaran penulis (opsional)

blocks.title: Ciri kebahasaan
blocks.html:
• Simple past tense: went, saw, helped, was.
  • Penanda waktu dan urutan: last Saturday, on the first day, then, after that, finally, by noon.
  • Kata kerja tindakan (action verbs) dan nama orang atau tempat yang spesifik.
  • Kata ganti orang pertama (I, we) untuk recount pribadi; orang ketiga untuk recount faktual.

blocks.title: Beda recount dan narrative
blocks.html: Keduanya memakai past tense. Recount berfokus pada urutan peristiwa nyata dan tidak harus punya konflik. Narrative punya komplikasi (masalah) dan resolusi, dan biasanya fiksi.

blocks.question: Which sentence is most likely the reorientation of a recount?

options.A: Last week, our class visited a tea factory in Puncak.
options.B: First, the guide showed us how the leaves were dried.
options.C: After lunch, we walked through the tea plantation.
options.D: It was a fun trip, and now I appreciate every cup of tea I drink.

blocks.explanation: Kalimat D berisi kesan dan pelajaran penulis. A adalah orientation; B dan C adalah events.

blocks.html:
My First Time Leading a Flag Ceremony

[Orientation] Last Monday, I was chosen to lead the flag ceremony at my school for the first time. I had practised with the other members of the ceremony team every afternoon for a week.

[Events] On Monday morning, I arrived at school at six o'clock, an hour earlier than usual. My hands were cold, and I kept repeating the commands in my head. At seven, all the students lined up in the field, and the ceremony began.

[Events (problem)] Everything went smoothly until the flag-raising. When the flag reached the middle of the pole, the rope got stuck. For a few seconds, nobody knew what to do. I stayed in position, as our coach had taught us, while one of the flag raisers calmly pulled the rope again. The flag finally reached the top, just as the choir finished singing Indonesia Raya.

[Reorientation] After the ceremony, the principal shook my hand and praised our team for staying calm. I learned that preparation and calmness are the keys to handling unexpected problems.

blocks.title: Soal urutan peristiwa
blocks.question: What happened right after the students lined up in the field?
steps: Cari penanda waktu: At seven, all the students lined up ... and the ceremony began.

blocks.title: Soal karakter (inferensial)
blocks.question: Which word best describes the writer during the problem with the rope?
steps: Petunjuk: I stayed in position, as our coach had taught us.
Kepala sekolah memuji tim karena tetap tenang.

blocks.question: Why did the writer most likely arrive at school at six o'clock?

options.B: The writer had to raise the flag.
options.C: The writer was nervous and wanted to be ready.
options.D: The coach asked everyone to come at six.

blocks.hint: Tidak dinyatakan langsung; lihat petunjuk perasaan.
blocks.explanation: Teks menyebut tangan dingin dan terus mengulang aba-aba, jadi penulis datang lebih awal karena gugup dan ingin bersiap. Upacara sendiri mulai pukul tujuh.

blocks.title: Mengurutkan peristiwa recount
blocks.caption: Susun kalimat menjadi recount yang runtut. Set kedua berisi recount faktual tentang Proklamasi Kemerdekaan.

blocks.title: Strategi mengerjakan
blocks.html:
• Lingkari setiap penanda waktu (on the second day, in the afternoon, after that) untuk membangun garis waktu.
  • Soal correct order sering memakai pengecoh berupa urutan yang terbalik satu langkah: periksa setiap tanda panah.
  • Pesan atau pelajaran biasanya ada di reorientation, kalimat terakhir.
  • Untuk soal karakter, cari tindakan tokoh, bukan hanya kata sifat yang disebut.

blocks.title: Jebakan yang sering muncul
blocks.html:
• Tertukar kegiatan yang dilakukan setiap hari dengan kegiatan yang terjadi sekali.
  • Mengira semua kalimat berisi angka adalah jawaban soal kapan.
  • Menganggap pendapat orang lain (Some people say ...) sebagai fakta yang terbukti.
Setelah memahami materi dan contoh di atas, kerjakan kuis bab ini. Bacalah teksnya dengan teliti, jawab tanpa melihat pembahasan, lalu pelajari pembahasan setiap soal yang salah.
